title: reWordBench: Benchmarking and Improving the Robustness of Reward Models with Transformed Inputs
authors_zh: Zhaofeng Wu, Michihiro Yasunaga, Andrew Cohen, Yoon Kim, Asli Celikyilmaz, Marjan Ghazvininejad
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Meaning-preserving input transformations audit whether reward models rely on brittle shortcuts.
reWordBench用语义或排序不变改写揭示奖励模型捷径，并以同分改写训练提升鲁棒性。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reward models can look strong on a fixed benchmark while relying on formatting or lexical shortcuts. If a meaning- or ranking-preserving rewrite changes the preferred answer, reward-driven alignment and test-time selection become unreliable.

reWordBench systematically transforms inputs and measures the resulting degradation, then trains reward models to give paraphrases similar scores.

奖励模型在固定 benchmark 上可能看似很强，却依赖格式或词面捷径；若语义或排序不变的改写改变偏好，对齐训练和 test-time selection 都会不可靠。

reWordBench 系统变换输入并测量性能退化，再训练奖励模型为 paraphrase 给出相近分数。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
reWordBench is a transformation-based robustness suite for reward models. It keeps meaning or ranking fixed while perturbing inputs, and pairs the audit with paraphrase-consistency training so equivalent responses receive similar rewards.

It is an evaluation and training augmentation, not a new preference dataset claim; code and benchmark materials are linked through the official RewardBench repository.

reWordBench 是奖励模型的变换鲁棒性套件：在保持语义或排序不变时扰动输入，并以 paraphrase 一致性训练使等价回复得到相近 reward。

它是评测与训练增强，而非声称发布全新偏好数据集；代码和 benchmark 材料由官方 RewardBench 仓库链接。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Start with a reward-model input and generate controlled transformations that preserve meaning or the preference ranking.
  2. Score original and transformed inputs with the same RM; performance change measures shortcut sensitivity.
  3. Train a robust RM with a consistency objective that encourages similar scores for paraphrases, then evaluate robustness and downstream alignment.

Pin transformation prompts, data split, base RM and RewardBench version. Inspect the repository for the exact license and generation controls.

1. 从奖励模型输入出发，生成保持语义或偏好排序不变的受控改写。
  2. 用同一 RM 对原始与改写输入打分，性能变化衡量其对捷径的敏感性。
  3. 以一致性目标训练 robust RM，鼓励 paraphrase 得到近似分数，再评测鲁棒性与下游对齐。

应固定变换提示词、数据 split、base RM 和 RewardBench 版本；精确许可与生成控制须查官方仓库。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
State-of-the-art RMs substantially degrade under minor transformations, sometimes below random accuracy. On RewardBench Chat Hard, the proposed robust RM cuts this degradation by roughly half; in alignment it wins up to 59% against a standard RM.

The evidence supports robustness for the chosen transformations and settings, not invariance under every adversarial rewrite or task distribution.

SOTA RM 在轻微变换下明显退化，有时准确率低于随机；在 RewardBench Chat Hard 上，robust RM 将该退化约减半，并在对齐使用中最多以 59% 胜率击败标准 RM。

证据支持所选变换和设置下的鲁棒性，不等于对所有对抗改写或任务分布都不变。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Standard RM evaluation mostly tests unmodified inputs. reWordBench changes the evaluation contract by preserving semantics/ranking while perturbing form, then makes invariance an explicit training target.

Paraphrase augmentation is not new; the contribution is its systematic reward-model audit and downstream alignment test.

标准 RM 评测多测试未改写输入。reWordBench 以保持语义/排序、扰动形式的方式改变评测契约，并把不变性变成显式训练目标。

paraphrase augmentation 并不新；贡献是系统性 RM 审计和下游对齐检验。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The audit assumes transformations preserve meaning or ranking; a bad transformation can be mistaken for a model failure. Consistency training can also suppress legitimate sensitivity where wording changes safety, intent, or evidence.

Validate transformations with humans or task-specific checks before using scores to reject a reward model.

该审计假设变换保持语义或排序；错误变换会被误判为模型失败。一致性训练也可能压平本应敏感的差异，例如措辞改变安全、意图或证据。

用分数否定一个 reward model 前，应以人工或任务专属检查验证变换。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use reWordBench before deploying an RM for preference optimization or best-of-N selection. Generate task-relevant invariance tests, measure score flips, then add paraphrase consistency only when the invariance contract is valid.

Report both original and transformed accuracy; do not apply it unchanged to domains where rewrites alter truth conditions.

在将 RM 用于偏好优化或 best-of-N 选择前，可用 reWordBench 生成任务相关不变性测试、测量分数翻转；只有不变性契约成立时才加入 paraphrase consistency。

同时报告原始和变换准确率；改写会改变真值条件的领域不可直接套用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: reward-model accuracy can conceal brittleness under meaning-preserving rewrites.
  • Lever: transformed inputs expose score flips; paraphrase consistency reduces them.
  • Artifact: reWordBench and implementation are linked from the official RewardBench repository.
  • Evidence: Chat Hard degradation is roughly halved; robust-RM alignment wins up to 59%.
  • Decision: validate transformation invariance before treating a score flip as a failure.

• 定位：奖励模型准确率可掩盖语义不变改写下的脆弱性。
  • 抓手：变换输入暴露分数翻转，paraphrase consistency 可减少翻转。
  • Artifact：reWordBench 与实现由官方 RewardBench 仓库链接。
  • 证据：Chat Hard 退化约减半；robust-RM 对齐最多胜出 59%。
  • 决策：把分数翻转判为失败前，先验证变换不变性。
